description: Beginner's guide to kickstarting programming: CS101 and beyond! > This blog is aimed towards students undertaking the CS101 (Computer Programming and Utilisation) course at IIT Bombay. But, it is helpful for anyone eager to commence their C++ programming journey. While we can’t easily bridge the knowledge gap, this presents a chance for beginners to kick off their learning journey the right way, and that’s precisely what this blog is here for. :   Students lack the same level of familiarity with programming as they do with other courses that they have been studying and developing an intuition for over the years. You would be surprised to know that a *single use* of this seemingly simple operation can evaluate the following mathematical expressions (of course, we will require a few variables to keep track of values). While the idea of making your computer do the work for you is exciting, the same can not be said about the learning process.
